ShortDescription.Value: Road Zoning and toggle Contour terrain lines. Roads can have zoning Left > Right > None > Both sides.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Easy Zoning
Custom zoning for new and existing roads. Newer alternative to Zone Tools.
### How to use
**New Road** 1. Open Roads panel (i.e., pick small roads) 2. Near the bottom of tool icons, pick one of 3 EZ icons (see image). 3. Draw as usual (road appears with cells on one side or no-sides if the 3 icons are flipped off).
**Existing Road** 1. Open EZ Update panel: Ctrl+V toggles panel On/Off (top-left icon does the same). 2. Select an icon to pick a preferred side (see image). 3. Hover and preview a road. 4. Right-Click to switch sides (infinitely); **RMB cycles** Both → Left → Right → None →... 5. Left-Click (LMB) to apply (lock it in). 6. Or LMB hold+drag along many road sections, release and update is applied. 7. To Cancel, just move mouse away and release. 8. Optional: **Contour Lines** terrain toggle
**Options Menu** - ✅ Protect occupied cells (buildings). - ✅ Protect zoned-but-empty cells. - ✅ Default **Ctrl +V** short-cut can be changed (it opens/closes EZ panel fast) - ✅ Choose transparent Glass panel or gray panel - ✅ Contour: choice to disable if a smaller panel is preferred or if another mod handles terrain lines. - ✅ **Legacy RMB mode** (optional): RMB toggles only **Left↔Right** Or **Both↔None** instead of all 4-cycles.
## Support and feedback
- If the mod helps you, give it a Like, it's free + easy :) - Feedback to GitHub or Discord links on this page.
Power Trick: if you have existing roads and do not want a new road intersecting it to alter zoning, pick **none**, then draw the new road. Your existing road should keep zoning facing the same original direction you set.
### Compatibility - Does not use Harmony patch; extends vanilla tools (means more stable on patch days, and compatibility). - Safe to remove any time. Road you zoned will keep their zoning. - Should work with Platter mod. - Lightweight, optimized, runs only when needed. - This mod has a different UX than Zone Tools. I had both EZ + ZT installed to switch back/forth for testing purposes and it was fine. - Recommend: pick one you like more to avoid any unknown future issues. Both use the same game systems, can accomplish the same goal. ZT is older, has a moveable panel; EZ is the newest mod + uses vanilla tool panel + sounds, smaller and tidy as it's in the same place as vanilla tool panel.
### Tech notes - For newly drawn roads, “Left/Right” is relative to the segment’s orientation. At some diagonal angles ↖||↗ it may apply flipped from what you want — use RMB to swap. - Highlight outline color on the road indicates the section could be changed. No outline means it's already changed to the current selected option. - Transparent panel does not use blur filter for better performance.
